page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system installations and persistent disk workloads. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No dedicated GPUs are attached to this hardware configuration, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With an 8.0 GB per vCPU memory allocation, the ecs.r9ae.2xlarge instance is configured for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Common deployment fits include in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, data processing pipelines, and enterprise application tiers where memory footprint requirements exceed typical compute demands.
